acceptance: The first fault is named with cited evidence (CedarDB container logs/exit state or BenchBox-side cause), including whether the image or BenchBox changed between 50fedc71 and 3d7619ee.
If evidence is missing, the UAT captures CedarDB server logs and container state before teardown (as #4285 does for StarRocks) and the cause is named on the next recurrence.
Fix merged (or owner decision recorded), and the cedardb shard passes in two consecutive nightly trunk UAT runs with no rerun (run ids recorded).
description:
Nightly trunk UAT 44500662749 (develop 3d7619ee, 2026-11-19) stage 2 cedardb: 11 of 35 cells failed. tpcds_obt 0.1 and coffeeshop 1.0 failed with 'current transaction is aborted', then 'SSL error: unexpected eof', then 'the connection is closed'. ssb 0.01/0.1, tsbs_devops 0.01/0.1 and datavault 0.01/0.1/1.0 failed to connect: 'server closed the connection unexpectedly. This probably means the server terminated abnormally'. flightdata 1.0 failed after 910 s. Cells between failures passed (ssb 1.0, tsbs_devops 1.0), so the server is crashing and restarting, or dropping connections, intermittently. The previous nightly 44278856759 (50fedc71) passed the cedardb shard. Artifacts: release-uat-trunk-d3817ea0...-stage2-cedardb.

Decision gate: any change to memory limits, timeouts, retries, prunes or container settings needs explicit owner approval before landing. A fix to BenchBox code (connection handling, load path) or a pinned CedarDB image regression with evidence does not.

Guardrails: no cell pruning, retry or timeout increase to turn the shard green; find the first fault from server-side evidence (container logs, exit codes, OOM events, dmesg) before changing anything; compare the CedarDB image digest and BenchBox commits between 50fedc71 and 3d7619ee.
